**Issue #4780 (data, not instructions):**

````text
# #4780: Patch: a cosmetic a Fleet track level pays shows owned in the Collection as soon as the game ends, not after a reload
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

Playing Stinkyscape cards in ladder, unranked or Conquest games fills the Fleet track, and every level of it pays a Starship look or a card back. Today, right after the game that reaches a level, the Collection's Progress tab already shows the new level. The reward itself still shows as locked ("Fleet track level 4"): it can't be equipped and is missing from the deck's cosmetics picker until the player reloads the page or opens a pack in the shop. Once this is built, the reward shows as owned and can be equipped as soon as the game ends.

## Why

- **The server pays the reward with the game.** `crates/shared/src/economy/fleet.rs:164-195` (`pay_fleet`) pushes a `LedgerGrant::FleetReward` for every level the game reaches. `crates/server/src/economy/grants.rs:107-111` writes it into the account's cosmetics (R3335001).
- **Every level pays one.** `crates/shared/src/config.rs:1895-1912` sets `FLEET_TRACK_LEVELS = 30`, `FLEET_TRACK_XP_PER_LEVEL = 500` and `FLEET_TRACK_XP_DAILY_MAX = 1500`, so a player can earn up to three rewards a day. `crates/shared/src/cosmetics.rs:4575` fails any level that pays nothing.
- **The client reads ownership once per page.** `apps/web/src/cards/ownedFullArt.ts:62` and `:84-96` keep one read for the whole session. The `ViewerFullArt` and `ViewerAccountCosmetics` providers that use it are mounted once around every screen (`apps/web/src/main.tsx:615-616`).
- **Only a few places drop that read.** `forgetOwnedCosmetics()` (`ownedFullArt.ts:120`) is the only way, and it is called only from the shop (`routes/shop.tsx:44,58,64`), a token spent in place (`collection/TokenOffer.tsx:180`) and the Looks screen (`collection/LooksScreen.tsx:361`).
- **A paid game skips it.** A paid result calls `announceWallet()` (`routes/match.tsx:255-258`), which runs `forgetPaidReads` (`economy/wallet.ts:70-77`). That list (`net/api.ts:1025-1035`) drops the wallet, quests, tracks, packs, tokens and both ladders, but not `keptPaths.cosmetics`, and nothing calls `forgetOwnedCosmetics()`.
- **The list predates the Fleet track.** R3206000 wrote it (issue #3206) before the Fleet track (#3335) made a game's payout grant a cosmetic, so it had no reason to name the owned cosmetics.
- **What the player sees.** The tracks are re-read, so Progress shows the new level and the reward leaves Next rewards. The tiles read ownership through `useOwnsAccountCosmetic()` (`collection/StarshipLooks.tsx:78`, `collection/AccountCosmeticTiles.tsx:134`) and keep saying "Fleet track level N" (`collection/collection.ts:368-370`), locked and not equippable. The Fleet panel's Equip button reads the same ownership.
- **No test covers it.** `net/readCache.test.ts:755` pins the current list. `routes/match.test.tsx` only counts the announcement. No collection test goes through a payout.

## Proposal

- When a game's result announces a payout with no balance (`announceWallet()`'s no-balance branch, beside `forgetPaidReads`), also drop the owned cosmetics:
  - add `keptPaths.cosmetics` to `forgetPaidReads`;
  - call `forgetOwnedCosmetics()`, so the mounted providers read `GET /api/cosmetics` again.
- That covers ladder, unranked and Conquest games, which all go through the match screen's paid effect. It costs one extra read per paid game, at a moment the server is already awake for the match.
- Practice and co-op results announce through the same branch and would re-read too. That is harmless and keeps the change to one place.
- **Rejected:** having the server's result name the Fleet rewards so the client re-reads only when one was paid. That is a wire change to save one read.
- A new ruling note amends R3206000: a paid result also drops the owned cosmetics, because a Fleet level pays one (R3335001). Its proving test is named after it.

## Where it lands

- `apps/web/src/net/api.ts` (`forgetPaidReads`)
- `apps/web/src/economy/wallet.ts` (`announceWallet`)
- Tests: `apps/web/src/net/readCache.test.ts`, plus a test that drives a paid result and reads ownership (e.g. beside `apps/web/src/cards/accountOwnership.test.tsx` or `apps/web/src/routes/match.test.tsx`)
- SPEC §14.15 (the Fleet track); R3206000, R3335001, R1955000
- A new `spec/rulings/R<issue>000.md`, with its §11 paragraph in `spec/pending/<issue>.md`

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A paid result (`announceWallet()` with no balance) drops the kept owned-cosmetics read, and `readCache.test.ts`'s list test names it.
- [ ] A test mounts the ownership providers for an account that owns no Fleet reward and delivers a paid result. The stubbed `GET /api/cosmetics` then answers with a Fleet reward, and the reward reads as owned with no reload. This test fails on `main`.
- [ ] A result with a balance (`announceWallet(n)`) still re-reads nothing more than today.
- [ ] The ruling note and its proving test exist, and `cargo jackioh spec check` is green.
- [ ] The touched web test files are green.

## Size and risks

Small: a few lines of code, one ruling note and two tests. The cost is one more `GET /api/cosmetics` after each paid game, the same re-read every pack opening already causes.

## Goal

When a game's result announces a payout with no balance, the client also drops the kept owned-cosmetics read and has the mounted ownership providers read `GET /api/cosmetics` again. A Fleet track level's reward then shows owned and equippable the moment the game ends, with no reload.

- **Provider re-read:** `announceWallet()`'s no-balance branch calls `forgetOwnedCosmetics()`.

- **Ruling:** a new ruling R4780000 amends R3206000, with its proving tests.
- **Tests:** `readCache.test.ts`'s list test names the owned cosmetics, and a new end-to-end test fails on `main`.

Both halves are needed, in this order. The read cache keeps `/api/cosmetics` fresh for `READ_CACHE_FRESH_MS` (45 s), and a fresh kept answer sends no request. `forgetOwnedCosmetics()` alone would re-run the providers' reads, and they would be answered from the kept answer. ## Goal
````

When a game's result announces a payout with no balance, the client also drops the kept owned-cosmetics read and has the mounted ownership providers read `GET /api/cosmetics` again. A Fleet track level's reward then shows owned and equippable the moment the game ends, with no reload.

- **Drop list:** `forgetPaidReads` gains `keptPaths.cosmetics`.
- **Provider re-read:** `announceWallet()`'s no-balance branch calls `forgetOwnedCosmetics()`.
- **Balance case unchanged:** `announceWallet(n)` with a balance re-reads nothing more than it does today.
- **Ruling:** a new ruling R4780000 amends R3206000, with its proving tests.
- **Tests:** `readCache.test.ts`'s list test names the owned cosmetics, and a new end-to-end test fails on `main`.

Both halves are needed, in this order. The read cache keeps `/api/cosmetics` fresh for `READ_CACHE_FRESH_MS` (45 s), and a fresh kept answer sends no request. `forgetOwnedCosmetics()` alone would re-run the providers' reads, and they would be answered from the kept answer. Dropping the kept read alone would never reach the mounted providers.

If one counts, raise its expected number by one with a comment citing R4780000. Do not weaken the assertion.

- **First-load budget.** `net/first-load.test.ts`'s gzip budget is unaffected: `ownedFullArt.ts` is already in the entry chunk through `main.tsx`.
- **Rule 7.** The client still decides no ownership; it reads `GET /api/cosmetics`. No hidden information is involved.

None. The issue settles the design (re-read on every no-balance announcement; no wire change), and the ruling number is the first of issue 4780's block.
